sharp-cel.name: Sharp cel
sharp-cel.description: Match the first style reference's sharp cel game pixels: bold irregular 1–2 native-pixel outer contour; angular flat shadow masses, 1-1 and 2-1 edge staircases, narrow dark purple eyelids, small restrained rectangular hair highlights, 2–3 skin planes. Pink hair needs separated angular clumps and flat pale rose highlights, not painted strands.

compact-fantasy.name: Compact fantasy
compact-fantasy.description: Match the second style reference's compact fantasy-RPG portrait: slightly rounder and compact facial proportions built from choppy angular little pixel steps, simple squared violet irises, strong readable lashes, short flat clusters of hair and broad dark contours. Cute but not chibi: keep the adult elegant shrine maiden silhouette. Flat 2–3-tone skin, no glossy doll eyes.

sparse-anime.name: Sparse anime
sparse-anime.description: Match the third style reference's sparse old game anime portrait: long simple planes, economical thin but deliberately stair-stepped outlines, minimal face marks, understated eyes and tiny lips. Few large calm pink hair masses, selective fringe breaks. Noticeably simpler and quieter than the other variants; do not add dense detail.

console-icon.name: Console icon
console-icon.description: Match the fourth style reference's visibly COARSE CONSOLE portrait: chunky squared pixels, bold readable silhouette, rough outline corners, very few face planes, blunt small violet eye clusters. Compact upper-chest portrait fills the square cell. The artwork must still be a visibly low-resolution 72x72 game icon, not a refined 96px portrait. Ornaments are 3–6px clusters; keep the identity readable at this scale.

rough-manga.name: Rough manga
rough-manga.description: Match the fifth style reference's rough manga game pixels: interrupted dark purple contours, controlled scratch/hatch clusters, broad violet and rose shadow shapes, sharper lashes, selective pixel flecks and choppy hair highlights. Richest of these styles but still obviously low-resolution jagged pixel art, not polished painted anime. Retain the flat color planes and raw edge texture.

refined-cel.name: Refined cel
refined-cel.description: A more refined pixel portrait: rounder facial features, fuller hair and ornament shapes, gentler shading and more elaborate highlights. Keep separate from the angular original Sharp cel design.
